en.title: Minimum Initial Health With One Armor Use and Health Always Positive
en.description:
You take the damage in the power array in order, and after every round your health must be strictly greater than 0. The armor can be used at most once; it reduces that round's damage by min(armor,power[i]) and does not restore health. Find the minimum initial health.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n armor and the second line contains power. The original bounds are 1≤n≤100000, 1≤power[i],armor≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 13, 1 and 8. In the second example all the damage can be blocked, but the initial health must still be at least 1.
hints: Subtract min(armor,max(power)) from the total damage, then add 1.
